notes.note: Reviewed cc5c74afb2b against loaded-history retention and observation freshness: the dock retains already rendered messages through a failed refresh, keeps the failure visible, accepts a successful empty read, and clears retained text when switching chats. No configuration key, authorization rule, live-status proof, layout geometry or Task shaping behavior changed. The canonical composer explanation now states this boundary. Existing activity-feed tests now use the real QueryClient cache; replay-fork hydration accounts for its optional scope argument. 86 focused tests passed; removing the retention fix and the post-mount freshness guard each caused the intended named assertion failure, and exact-byte restoration returned green. No hosted/native/provider completion is claimed.
